name: mode-f-drain
description: Drains 5 independent shards concurrently: one `parallel` over 5 self-draining `repeat` branches, each branch one `step`. Each branch owns exactly one shard state file under .kiro-harness/drain/ and terminates on that file alone, so the branches share no state and no branch can observe another. Generated by generate.sh — edit K there, not here.

steps.prompt:
Goal: {{goal}}

You are draining shard 01 of 5. Your shard state file is .kiro-harness/drain/shard-01.json, a JSON object of the form {"items": [{"id": "...", "done": false}], "drained": false}.

If it does not exist, create it: decompose your share of the goal into items, each with "done": false, and set top-level "drained": false.

If it does exist, take the FIRST item whose "done" is false, complete just that one item, then write the file back with that item marked "done": true. Set top-level "drained": true only when no item with "done": false remains.

Write NOTHING outside .kiro-harness/drain/shard-01.json. The other 4 branches are draining their own shard files concurrently and a write into another shard corrupts a sibling mid-run.
